issues.title: Reduce transparency of channels
issues.body:
Ian realised that `maximise view` could be a useful tool for players keeping track of lots of channels.

But, the semi-transparent channels show the content underneath, which gives a confused UI.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/124633598-539cdf00-de7d-11eb-8b53-21ba42d0a075.png)

We should reduce the transparency of channels, so the channels behind the maximised one are less (or not) visible.
